The subsequent dowield sees welded(uwep), calls weldmsg, resets armor-removal state and returns ECMD_FAIL without changing weapon slots. Whole-function closure also includes bare-handed petrifying corpse, two-handed shield conflict, retouch failure, artifact speech/light and unpaid-shop branches; these are not covered by this admitted case.
